### Load Data
Two forecast providers and two observation networks, 27 Canadian cities, collected twice daily since July 2026.

```{r load-data}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "weather.db")
forecasts <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM forecasts")
observations <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM observations")
dbDisconnect(con)

forecasts <- forecasts %>%
  filter(source %in% c("open-meteo", "ec")) %>%
  mutate(target_date = as.Date(target_date))

observations <- observations %>%
  filter(source %in% c("open-meteo", "ec")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

forecasts %>% count(source)
observations %>% count(source)
```
